top_choice_rationale: P001 honours a concrete, independently reproduced discovery with clean two-name credit: state-insensitive trapping of many neutral atoms at a magic wavelength, developed by Katori and Ye to roughly 1e-18 fractional uncertainty. The citation scope (lattice, neutral atoms, accuracy) separates it from the 2005 comb and 2012 single-ion prizes. P002 is a strong, real discovery, but the open pairing mechanism, the eight-year maturity gap and the contested exclusion of Eva Andrei make it a less secure award than P001, though still better than no award.
